chunks: But God is your protector, and He is the best of helpers.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is the best of helpers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm that divine guardianship (Wilayah) is not merely a spiritual concept but a practical reality where God actively intervenes on behalf of the faithful. It underscores the superiority of Allah's aid over human or earthly powers, reinforcing the believer's reliance on the Ultimate Protector in times of trial.
